1.translation: When the sky is rent asunder,

2.translation: and hearkens to its Lord[1], as it must,

3.translation: and when the earth is leveled out[2],

4.translation: and casts out all what it contains[3], and becomes empty,
4.footnotes: [3] i.e., its dead bodies and treasures buried in it.

5.translation: and hearkens to its Lord, as it must,

6.translation: O humans, you are toiling towards your Lord[4], and you will surely meet Him[5].
6.footnotes:
[4] i.e., striving in doing good or evil until you meet your Lord.
 [5] To be recompensed by Him for your deeds.

7.translation: Whoever is given his Record in his right hand,

8.translation: he will have an easy reckoning,

9.translation: and he will return to his people joyfully.

10.translation: But whoever is given his Record from behind his back,

11.translation: he will call out for destruction,

12.translation: and he will enter the Blazing Fire.

13.translation: Indeed, he used to live among his people joyfully.

14.translation: and he thought that he would never return [to Allah].

15.translation: Indeed he will! His Lord was always watching him.

16.translation: Indeed, I swear by the twilight,

17.translation: and by the night and what it covers,

18.translation: and by the moon when it becomes full,

19.translation: You will surely pass from one stage to another[6].
19.footnotes: [6] i.e., from sperm-drop to clinging clot to lump, from life to death to resurrection.

20.translation: Then what is the matter with them that they do not believe,

21.translation: and when the Qur’an is recited to them, they do not prostrate?

22.translation: Rather, the disbelievers persist in denying it,

23.translation: but Allah knows best whatever they harbor in their hearts.

24.translation: So give them the tidings of a painful punishment.

25.translation: But those who believe and do righteous deeds will have a never-ending reward.
